description: Task 0: scaffold and contracts. Greenfield setup that all parallel tasks (FEAT-002 to FEAT-007) build on. Creates the npm project, strict TypeScript, Vitest + fast-check, ESLint (with a rule forbidding @forge/* imports under src/core), Playwright + Vite skeleton for static/ui, manifest.yml with every module key from PLAN.md section 4, the contract types in src/core/model.ts (PLAN.md 7.1), wording stubs, and the banned-words and manifest contract tests.
steps: Create package.json (type module, engines node >= 22) with scripts: typecheck (tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json and -p static/ui/tsconfig.json), lint (eslint .), test (vitest run), test:watch, build:ui (vite build in static/ui), test:e2e (playwright test), forge:lint (forge lint).
Create tsconfig.json with strict true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noImplicitOverride, module/moduleResolution NodeNext or Bundler as Forge supports; include src and test.
Create eslint.config.js (typescript-eslint strict) with no-restricted-imports banning '@forge/*' and 'node:*' network modules inside src/core/**.
Create vitest.config.ts (test/**/*.test.ts, coverage via v8, thresholds for src/core at 90% lines once code exists).

Create manifest.yml exactly as drafted in PLAN.md section 4 (placeholder app id until forge login), with handlers pointing at stub files: src/resolvers/ui.ts, src/resolvers/byline.ts, src/actions/checkPage.ts, src/actions/checkClaim.ts, src/consumers/indexRepo.ts. Stubs return typed placeholder values.

Create src/core/model.ts with the types in PLAN.md 7.1 (Verdict, ClaimType, Coverage, Claim, NormalizedClaim union per type, Evidence, ClaimResult, ReasonCode union, Report, RepoIndex with per-kind entry types and coverage) and the agent envelope type pil.agent.v1 from PLAN.md 9.2.
Create src/core/wording.ts with the template functions listed in PLAN.md 7.4 (can return the template strings with placeholders filled from arguments).
Create prompts/runbook-checker.md from PLAN.md 9.3 and an empty skills/runbook-checker/SKILL.md placeholder.

Create static/ui (React 18 + Vite + TS strict) skeleton that routes by context.moduleKey (runbook-check, runbook-byline, runbook-settings) with a src/bridge.ts wrapper around @forge/bridge so Playwright can alias it to e2e/bridge-mock.ts via a vite.config.e2e.ts; add playwright.config.ts with one smoke test.

Add test/wording/banned-words.test.ts: scans src/core/wording.ts, static/ui/src/**/*.tsx string literals, prompts/runbook-checker.md and skills/**/SKILL.md for whole-word, case-insensitive 'wrong' and 'safe'; fails on any hit.

Add test/manifest/manifest.test.ts: parses manifest.yml (yaml package) and asserts every action has actionVerb GET, rovo:mcp tools reference existing action keys, rovo:agent name and rovo:mcp name are at most 30 chars, scopes are exactly [storage:app, read:page:confluence], egress backend list is exactly [api.github.com, codeload.github.com].

Run npm install, npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test, npm run build:ui, npm run test:e2e and fix until green. If forge CLI is installed and logged in, also run forge lint; otherwise record that it is deferred.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test, npm run build:ui and npm run test:e2e all exit 0

manifest.yml contains modules macro runbook-check (layout bodied), confluence:contentBylineItem runbook-byline, confluence:globalSettings runbook-settings (useAsConfig true), rovo:agent runbook-checker, action check-page and check-claim (GET), rovo:mcp runbook-checker-mcp, consumer repo-index-consumer, and the five function keys
src/core/model.ts exports the PLAN.md 7.1 types and compiles under strict settings
Banned-words and manifest contract tests exist and pass
An ESLint error is raised if a file under src/core imports from @forge/api
verification: npm run build:ui && npm run test:e2e
forge lint (only if the user has installed and logged in to the Forge CLI)
findings: All gates exit 0 on Node 22.14.0 and 24.22.1: typecheck, lint, test (18 tests in 3 files), build:ui, test:e2e (3 Playwright smoke tests), forge lint (No issues found). Forge CLI 15.1.0 (needs Node ^22.23.4||^24.22.1, run with nvm Node 24 on PATH). Logged in; registered app 49ffa6f4-93eb-41fb-8f2a-6a087aac4ac0 (developer space 18159bee-..., named LotZero); demo site https://one-atlas-obka.atlassian.net already existed (expires 2027-01-26); deployed to development (app version 2.0.0) and installed for Confluence. Deviations: egress also lists api.bitbucket.org and bitbucket.org (decision 6); agent icon removed from manifest; action descriptions shortened (255 char limit); tsconfig.json has no noEmit (Forge ts-loader needs emit); added test/lint/core-purity.test.ts for the ESLint boundary rule. Open: Bitbucket tarball redirect host unverified (Task B); production deploy not done; nothing pushed. See PLAN.md section 19.1.
